scope: One 0.74-to-0.75 migration attempt on a cold copy of the stopped R16b Truss 0.0.51 PostgreSQL 18.6 fixture, followed by one separate read-only source ACL diagnostic

causeAnalysis.finding: The source ACL was exact. The only newly expected PUBLIC privilege in the target profile is USAGE on the generated array type. The migration ownership cohort revoked table privileges but not the associated composite row type's default PUBLIC USAGE.
causeAnalysis.evidence: Migration execution verifies the source profile before applying the edge, then verifies the target profile after all edge steps. The installed target privilege verifier uses the PUBLIC role profile. The installer privilege normalizer explicitly revokes PUBLIC from composite types while its native ACL inventory retains the default PUBLIC USAGE entry on base/array types.
causeAnalysis.inference: The target-verification failure is consistent with an extra PUBLIC USAGE privilege on composite type truss.runtime_feed_source_custody. The failed transaction rolled back, so that transient target ACL row was not captured directly.
causeAnalysis.correction: Add REVOKE ALL ON TYPE truss.runtime_feed_source_custody FROM PUBLIC to the forward edge ownership statements. Preserve the captured PUBLIC USAGE grant on array type truss._runtime_feed_source_custody.

limitations: The corrected edge has not been applied natively.
The target verification failure's exact transient ACL rows were inferred from the source-verified execution order and target/profile delta, not directly retained.
No source custody open/renew/ACK/reconcile/close behavior was qualified.
